english.title: Cause live Schedule 1 wild bird to be shown in competition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused to be shown

(A)_[for the purposes of competition]_
(B)_[in premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..) in which a competition was being held]_

(C)_[a live wild bird]_
(D)_[live wild birds]_
(E)_[a live bird, one of whose parents was a wild bird]_

included in Schedule 1 to the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, namely **(..SPECIFY SPECIES OF SCHEDULE 1 WILD BIRD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 6(3) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Does not apply to birds or birds with a parent listed in Part I of Schedule 3 to the Act.
(ii) See Section 27 for meaning of "wild bird".
(iii) See Section 21(6) for the forfeiture provisions.
(iv) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(v) As amended by paragraph 10 of Schedule 12 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(vi) See offence wordings as follows: H4610 and H4612.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Where more than one bird is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each bird (Section 21(5)).

Complex - see legislation
